tier_label: Substitution justification - only when swapping a stock

sulfur.printed_text: Sulfur, ppm, max, ASTM D-2622: Specification 10; Typical <3 (columns 'Specification 70N' and 'Typical (2017 AUG) 70N')
sulfur.calculation_note: Typical value from the column headed 'Typical (2017 AUG)'; '2017 AUG' dates the typical data, not the document. The typical is printed '<3' (below 3 ppm), not an exact value.

saturates.printed_text: Saturates, wt%, min, ASTM D-7419: Specification 'Report'; Typical 100 (columns 'Specification 70N' and 'Typical (2017 AUG) 70N')
saturates.calculation_note: Typical value from the column headed 'Typical (2017 AUG)'; '2017 AUG' dates the typical data, not the document. Printed as '100' without a qualifier; the specification is 'Report' (no minimum given for 70N).

aromatics.printed_text: Aromatics, wt%, max, ASTM D-7419: Specification 'Report'; Typical 0 (columns 'Specification 70N' and 'Typical (2017 AUG) 70N')
aromatics.calculation_note: Typical value from the column headed 'Typical (2017 AUG)'; '2017 AUG' dates the typical data, not the document. Printed as '0' without a qualifier; the specification is 'Report' (no maximum given for 70N).

cloud_point.calculation_note: No cloud point printed on DL2-12108.jpeg.

wax_content.calculation_note: No wax content printed on DL2-12108.jpeg.

open_questions: Saturates and aromatics typicals are printed as exactly '100' and '0' wt% (ASTM D-7419), without the '>'/'<' qualifiers used for 150N and 500N ('>99.80', '<0.20'); recorded as printed, not normalized. Confirm with the supplier.
Cloud point and wax content are not printed on DL2-12108.jpeg.
